title: Anyone using G6 with Xdrip on Samsung S7 willing to share settings?
body:
I just can`t set this all to work.
Would anyone please help me and send screen with all the settings?

comments.body: Please update to the latest nightly and disable the `Minimize Scanning` option in the G5 Debug settings.
wow, that was a terse and incomplete answer for the OP.  they wanted screen shots which are very helpful given how many options there are, with very little instructions.

download the 7/15/18 version, take the defaults and it should work.  My wife and I both have S7 phones with android 7.0.0 and the 7/15/18 version works fine.  I even have a Note 2 set up to follow me, using a copy of xdrip on that phone, set as "follower".   I think since that build, things have gone downhill, IMO.  I complained 190 days ago about subsequent builds not working with my gear 2, to no avail, so my wife and I both continue to stick with the 7/15/18 version.  I'm not sure how many days after that, a newer version would still work with our Gear 2's, but within a week or two, it all went to h*ll and I'm not about to try every single nightly as an experiment to see the precise date that they broke the code.

@torent5 If the problem is resolved, would you please close the issue?
Thanks
